title: characterframe
summary: CharacterFrame now has deterministic exact laws and sufficient draw telemetry for the next live comparison, with the reproduced portrait ordering and missing interaction/content paths repaired. It remains implemented/unverified until connected-client pixel, input, protocol, dynamic, and audio acceptance is captured.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI has the complete character-panel open/close, page/tab, player identity, guild refresh, and visibility lifecycle through its native immediate-mode page state.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI now applies deterministic green, red, or normal character-stat text colors from the net modifier sign.

MSUI diverges from Benilla — decide: port Benilla behavior, or record a decision preserving MSUI (only allowed if UI/graphics). MSUI already had complete character statistics, resistances, and tooltips; its broad panels, Attack/Ranged labels and values, damage format, and no-ranged semantics are preserved instead of adopting Benilla's different presentation.
openItems.resolution: Nico's 2026-08-23 no-touch ruling preserves the established MSUI Character statistics presentation under decision 0001; state, data, tooltip and wire behavior remain must-match.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI now routes equipment through exact slot endpoints and one law-bound path for clicks, modifiers, right-click use, drag/drop, auto-equip, tooltips, counts, and locked/broken/fit visual states.

MSUI diverges from Benilla — decide: port Benilla behavior, or record a decision preserving MSUI (only allowed if UI/graphics). Held rotation, release sounds, and model-pane auto-equip are present; MSUI's established zero facing and 0.12-radian tap are deliberately preserved instead of Benilla's different constants.
openItems.resolution: Nico's 2026-08-23 no-touch ruling preserves the established MSUI model facing and rotation-tap presentation under decision 0001; model lifecycle and behavior remain must-match.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI has the authored ammo slot, PLAYER_AMMO_ID binding, exact carried-ammunition filter and total count, and the build-5875 CMSG_SET_AMMO entry body.

MSUI diverges from Benilla — decide: port Benilla behavior, or record a decision preserving MSUI (only allowed if UI/graphics). MSUI's complete native character-frame composition is preserved; no Benilla coordinate, tab, background-slice, or header difference is treated as authorization to replace it.
openItems.resolution: Nico's 2026-08-23 no-touch ruling preserves the complete native Character page composition under decision 0001.
